name: registerPromptOverrides
description: Register conditional (provider, locale) overrides for system-prompt section holders into the process-global PromptHolderRegistry. Called once at boot by nexus_web so prompt prose can be varied per provider/locale without changing the per-turn payload. Replaces all prior registrations.

inputs.name: entries
inputs.description: Override entries. Each object: { provider?: string, locale?: string (empty/absent axis = wildcard; all-empty = unconditioned default), holder: string, content: string }.
